author: jsign
content:
New zkEVM test release: [tests-zkevm@v21.0.7](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/releases/tag/tests-zkevm%40v21.0.7).

Some of the changes:
- Based on tests@v21.0.2.
- `NewPayloadRequest` and `StatelessValidationResult` are now progressive SSZ containers, as in Gloas. The encoding is the same, but `new_payload_request_root` now matches what the CL computes, so `statelessOutputBytes` changes in the fixtures.
- Witness trie nodes are now checked only when the block reaches them.
- New tests put a malformed node on the block's path, such as a leaf path of the wrong length, invalid RLP, a branch with one child or a short node referenced by hash. They replace the over-length tests from the last release.

Recommend seeing full [release description](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/releases/tag/tests-zkevm%40v21.0.7) which has more details and linked PRs.
